name: obsidian-claude
description: Personal knowledge management system integrating Obsidian with Claude Code

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @obsidian-claude/server" "npm run dev -w @obsidian-claude/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @obsidian-claude/shared && npm run build -w @obsidian-claude/server && npm run build -w @obsidian-claude/web
